_comment: Classes the site emits that deliberately have no CSS rule. Each needs a reason, so that an entry added to silence a real regression has to be argued for in a diff.
line: Chroma wraps each code line in <span class="line">. Coder gave it display:flex to align an inline line-number gutter; line numbers are configured to render in a table instead, and the lines already break on the newlines inside <pre>.
cl: Chroma's inner per-line span. Purely a hook for line highlighting, which .chroma .hl handles.
footnote-ref: Goldmark marks the superscript link; .footnotes and sup[id^=fnref] carry the styling. Unstyled on master too.
language-go: Goldmark echoes the fence's language as a class. Informational only — Chroma does the highlighting.
social-icon: No longer emitted; retained here so a stale reference is caught rather than silently reappearing.
home: Structural hook on the home page's PageShell. .ds-split supplies the layout; this exists to scope descendants.
home__content: Structural hook. The measure comes from [data-prose] and the column from .ds-split.
recipe: Structural hook on a cocktail page. The layout comes from .ds-split and the page-header/rail/body classes; this exists to scope descendants.
